      North is at the top of each circle. The middle is straight overhead.

      How this page works. Nothing here comes from a sky service. Your phone works out every position itself, from the orbits of the planets and the Moon, for stars and towns.

      Claude, an AI made by Anthropic (the Fable 5.2 model), designed the page, wrote the astronomy and tested it against an independent reference: across 3,600 test cases every planet lands within a tenth of a degree, a fifth of the Moon’s width. It was built in a single conversation, in about an hour.
